note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official text. Guides are written for this entry, in its own words, and cite their sources beside each trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done. There is no shortcut — A Long Road (100% completion) is the long pole, at roughly 200 hours. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then side stories, activities, robberies, collectibles, and the money cleanup. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back.
steps: Finish the story (Chapters 1-4 and the final mission)
Finish the side stories and stranger strands
Clear the activities, robberies and collectibles
Reach 100% completion — the platinum pops with it

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission: play it and the trophy pops at the end. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed — it is part of the story. Note: GTA 6 has no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter as insurance for the rest of the run.
steps: Start a new game
Play the mission Gone Fishing to the end

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it does not pop immediately. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in the chapter that can disappear.
steps: Play through Chapter 1
Before the chapter ends: do Lucia's balcony meditation

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 — from here you can call the other in as your partner, which most of the list needs. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.
steps: Play through Chapter 2
After Breakfast Run, learn to switch characters and call in your partner

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The robbery tools arrive in this chapter: the Snap Gun comes from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Sneakthief), and Yago's street-racing strand has a time-sensitive race (Race Against Yago, hourglass icon) that counts toward Strangers & Freaks — save first, then race.
steps: Play through Chapter 3
Do the Snap Gun mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs
Race Against Yago the moment it appears (save first)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Bank vaults unlock near the end of this chapter through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is — bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the bags alone, and escaping with your partner also earns Hot Together.
steps: Play through Chapter 4
Do the optional mission That's Where The Money Is to open bank vaults

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so this save is your way back if you want to replay the ending or clean up anything the finale locks.
steps: Make a manual save just before the final mission
Play the final mission to the end

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after it. Story mission trophies unlock automatically and cannot be missed.
steps: Play the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story trophy — it pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.
steps: Play the mission The Cartel Heist

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story trophy — it pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.
steps: Play the mission Child's Play

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story trophy — it pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.
steps: Play the mission Headliners

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The airport (VCIA) is also where Catch Me If You Can happens — but that one needs a plane at a boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4), not just the mission.
steps: Play the mission VCIA Takedown

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy — it pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.
steps: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) only appears after the story, but work you do earlier still counts, and nothing on it is missable. It is a 35-task checklist covering story, robberies, gang operations, collectibles, races, stunts, challenges and discoveries. PowerPyx calls it roughly 60% of 'true completion' and the hardest trophy; expect about 200 hours for the platinum. Watch the higher thresholds: 300 stunts (the trophy is 250), 70 of 80 challenges (the trophy is 50), all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, 200 of 277 vehicle models (the trophy is 100).
steps: Finish the story
Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story
Work the 35-task checklist to 100%

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going past 250 — 100% completion needs 300. Stunts are the long grind: fold them into free-roam driving and flying rather than grinding them in one sitting.
steps: Stunt jumps off ramps
Under-the-bridge and knife flights
Base jumps
Track the count in Progress > Stats

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — all 9 types. The activities include the shooting range, drone races, street races, fishing, arcade games, meditation and more; the in-game activity list shows which you have tried. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything.
steps: Open the in-game activity list
Try each of the 9 activity types once

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 gold medals across two shooting ranges. Each challenge shows its gold threshold in-game; retrying is free, so treat it as practice: learn the target pattern, then go for gold. This is one of the two silver trophies most guides call a skill check.
steps: Find a shooting range
Complete each challenge
Retry until gold on all 42

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations. You only need one win per location, not every race at each one. Drone races are a flying-skill check: cut the corners tight and learn each course's line; retrying is free.
steps: Visit each of the 14 Top Fun locations
Win at least one drone race at each

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different race events count — winning the same race twice does not add a second one. Mix street races, drone races and any other race type; the race list shows which you have won. Race Against Yago (Chapter 3, time-sensitive) also counts toward Strangers & Freaks — do it when it appears.
steps: Win 20 different race events
Mix race types
Do Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 when it appears

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are an activity you can retry — learn the reeling rhythm (steady tension, do not snap the line) and challenge Cal again until you win.
steps: Find a fishing challenge
Challenge Cal
Retry until you beat him

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts — pick the one you find easiest and finish a full game.
steps: Find an arcade
Pick any of the four games
Finish a full game

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Side-story finales stay open after the main story, so you can finish Andy's strand in the post-game. Note: Andy's strand does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks (it has its own trophy) — check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.
steps: Play Andy's mission strand
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Side-story finales stay open after the main story, so you can finish Kenton's strand in the post-game.
steps: Play Kenton's mission strand
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Side-story finales stay open after the main story. Note: Billy's strand does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks (it has its own trophy).
steps: Play Billy's mission strand
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do NOT (they have their own trophies). Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One strand to plan around: Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) — save first, then race.
steps: Play stranger mission strands
Skip Andy, Billy and Tyrone for this counter
Watch the trophy's progress counter
Do Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 when it appears

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Side-story finales stay open after the main story, so you can finish Randy's strand in the post-game.
steps: Play Randy's mission strand
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Side-story finales stay open after the main story. Note: Tyrone's strand does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks (it has its own trophy).
steps: Play Tyrone's mission strand
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: The only trophy any guide flags as possibly missable: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward it and disappears after that chapter. It is not confirmed that the trophy strictly needs it — do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. This is the one reported missable trophy: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward it and disappears after that chapter. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time) — she heads to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate; follow her and accept the optional task. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close; each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time.
steps: Chapter 1: do Lucia's balcony meditation (do not skip it)
Find the 18 meditation spots (purple icons when close)
Meditate with both Jason and Lucia at each spot

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine — use a scoped rifle and take your time.
steps: Play as Jason
Follow Bret's hunting questline and its target decks
Take a clean head or heart shot on the unique animal

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are a collectible hunt across Leonida — collect full sets (any 3 sets count). Track your sets in the collectibles menu and sweep each area as you explore it, rather than leaving all the hunting for the end.
steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore
Track full sets in the collectibles menu
Complete any 3 sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK app is also how you discover vehicles (scanning traffic counts toward Whip It Good), so fold the two together: drive around scanning cars and WAiNK-ing locations as you go.
steps: Open the WAiNK app
WAiNK It at 100 locations while you drive
Scan traffic as you go — it counts toward Whip It Good too

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges; many complete on their own while you play. 100% completion needs 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50.
steps: Open Progress > Challenges
Work the list as you play
Keep going to 70 of 80 for 100% completion

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Call your partner in first (switching opens after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2). The easiest reliable way: rob a bank vault (That's Where The Money Is, end of Chapter 4) — vault jobs give you 4 stars straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this at the same time. The trophy pops only once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
steps: Call your partner in
Get a 4-star wanted level (a bank vault does it at once)
Escape until you have left the red heat zone

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop — give it a moment before you hit a fourth.
steps: Call your partner in
Rob three shops in a row while the police are chasing you
Do not let the stars fade between shops

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models — keep scanning past 100.
steps: Open the WAiNK app while driving
Scan traffic as you go
Keep going to 200 of 277 models for 100% completion

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies — the guards at an illegal operation work well — and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.
steps: Find a group of gang enemies (an illegal operation's guards)
Aim and press L3 + R3 for Combat Focus
Down 5 enemies before Focus ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first — the police come fast.
steps: Go to VCIA
Take a large plane docked at a boarding bridge (gates E3 or E4)
Back out, take off, and fly about 1 km away

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — get into a military tank. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station (far southwest island)
Find a tank parked on the south side
Get in, drive and fire until it pops

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
steps: Do Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) to get the Snap Gun
Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door
Find the safe code note, open the safe, leave unseen

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.
steps: Do That's Where The Money Is (end of Chapter 4)
Tail an armored van to a bank, enter the open vault
Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone
Escape, and repeat for 5 vaults (8 for 100%)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run the roads of Leonida — tail one, stop it, take the cash and escape the heat. The trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road
Stop it and take the cash
Escape until you have left the red heat zone

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Just drive and fly through every named area; the map fills in as you go. Fold it into the WAiNK and vehicle-discovery driving so it happens on its own.
steps: Drive and fly through every named area
Watch the map fill in
Sweep any area left grey on the map

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one operation from each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way. Operations are the gang hideouts and businesses marked on the map; each gang's territory shows which is theirs.
steps: Find illegal operations on the map
Rob one operation from each of the nine gangs
Keep going to all 39 for 100% completion

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Method unconfirmed at launch — no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet. The description points at Ocean Beach: try the beachfront bars with a view of the water and order a cocktail. Check the linked sources for updates as players confirm it.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach
Find a beachfront bar with a view
Order a cocktail

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Method unconfirmed at launch. The description suggests a set-piece moment: drive a car through a dealership showroom's frontage. Try the vehicle showrooms in Vice City; check the linked sources for updates as players confirm the trigger.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom in Vice City
Drive a car out through the showroom frontage

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later — it is not missable.
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling (Chapter 2 illegal operation)
Bring Sticky Bombs
Take the watch, the shotgun and the safe contents
Escape the police

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. It should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there — the partner trains alongside you.
steps: Buy a gym membership
Train with your partner at the gym
Bring both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. One warning from the guides: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent.
steps: Play normally — robberies and fights feed the count
Watch the Criminal Profile counter
Do not push toward the Irredeemable profile (permanent)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Method unconfirmed at launch — the name suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt after failing once. Keep playing normally and it may pop on its own; check the linked sources for updates as players confirm the trigger.
steps: Keep playing normally
If an attempt fails, try it again right away

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Method unconfirmed at launch — the name suggests witnessing something strange in the world (a random event or easter egg). Keep an eye out while free-roaming; check the linked sources for updates as players confirm it.
steps: Free-roam and watch for strange events
Check the linked sources for confirmed triggers

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Method unconfirmed at launch. The name describes the act: knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — like bowling pins. Try a slow drive-by with a melee weapon in traffic; check the linked sources for updates as players confirm the trigger.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle
Drive slowly through a crowd and strike with melee

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; launder them by selling them to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative — it adds up across the whole run.
steps: Do bank and payday loan jobs for marked bills
Sell the bills to your contacts
Reach $250,000 laundered in total

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — it adds up naturally as you buy weapons, clothes, food and cars. The eight garages (about $160,000 for all of them) alone cover it.
steps: Buy weapons, clothes, food and cars as you play
Buy the eight garages to cover the total in one go

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — all eight. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver
Open the Vice City Real Estate app
Buy all eight garages

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses
Take a stolen car to Moses: Respray, then Register
Repeat for 10 vehicles (Pay 'n' Spray works from Chapter 3)
